messages:
leo_sales: Heads-up 9: Prospect "Aether Instruments" ready for a 2-week POC. Procurement will only accept invoices billed from our EU entity but their PO references the MSA executed with Redwood US. They also attached DPA redlines and asked for a short SLA line (availability target + credit). Can we do a 1-page addendum and single e-sign envelope to avoid redoing the MSA? @maria_legal @jon_finance

maria_legal: Yes we can. Plan: (1) create a 1-page "Billing Linkage Addendum" that designates Redwood Inference EU Ltd as the billing counterparty for the Order Form (OF) only, (2) expressly link the OF to the existing US MSA (so MSA terms still govern), and (3) include a narrowly scoped cross-entity indemnity statement limited to POC activities. I'll include an "Electronic signatures binding" clause for DocuSign. Need KYC for Aether EU and to confirm which Redwood entity processes data.

jon_finance: Finance checklist: if billing = EU then invoices must go to our EU bank, include EU VAT reg no, and be issued in EUR. We need PO number on invoice (they gave PO: AI-2026). For SLA credit, preserve revenue recognition: credits should be applied as a credit note, cap at a percentage of invoice (we usually allow up to 10% for trials). If cross-entity arrangement is used, Treasury requires an internal AR memo to explain intercompany settlement. Also confirm net terms (they requested net30).

harper_solutions: Delivery note: POC will process non-sensitive telemetry, but the customer asked for the DPA to state EU controller language. Ops can keep processing in EU region to satisfy that. No infra changes expected. For a faster path: if they accept a hosted trial credit (internal coupon), we can avoid cross-entity billing, but their procurement insists on an invoice for PO reconciliation.

leo_sales: Aether provided VAT: ES21212121, currency EUR, PO AI-2026, asks for invoice to "Redwood Inference EU Ltd". POC fee EUR 8,000. Timeline: need signed docs by Tuesday EOD to start Wed. They prefer DocuSign single envelope binding OF + addendum + DPA.

maria_legal: I'll draft the addendum now: items to include: entity identification; explicit language "This Order Form is billed by Redwood Inference EU Ltd. The terms of the MSA dated <date> between Customer and Redwood Inference US Inc. shall apply to this Order Form except as modified herein." Limited indemnity paragraph for POC only. SLA language suggestion: "Target availability: 99.5% during the POC; monetary remedy limited to a credit not to exceed 10% of the POC fee." Thoughts?

jon_finance: 99.5% + 10% credit cap sounds fine from finance; please avoid long-term credits that complicate close. Net30 accepted. Treasury needs executed docs by Tue 16:00 CET to align with this billing cycle. We'll pre-create a provisional invoice once entity is set. Invoice-bot please prepare draft INV-AI2026 for EUR 8,000 (status: draft).

esign-bot: esign-bot: Recommended envelope: OF + Billing Linkage Addendum + DPA redline summary. Single envelope, Customer signs first, Redwood EU signer second. Template path: /ops/templates/billing-linkage-addendum-v3.docx. Audit trail and entity lines required.

harper_solutions: Ops will confirm EU-region processing and provide subprocessor list link for the DPA. If DPA requires controller language, we'll ensure the DPA references Redwood Inference EU Ltd as controller for this OF. Otherwise link to MSA controller terms.

maria_legal: Good. I'll include two signature blocks: (a) for Redwood Inference EU Ltd (for billing and OF execution) and (b) for Redwood Inference US Inc (reference on MSA link) if needed to avoid ambiguity. But to keep it simple, better to have OF executed by Redwood EU with an explicit sentence that MSA remains the governing contract. Circulating redline to #legal-drafts in 20m.

leo_sales: Sending KYC & PO to legal now. Routing to Aether for e-sign once redline ready. Will update if they push for wet-ink. Also will ask them to confirm billing contact and whether they need the invoice to reference a particular procurement code.

jon_finance: Once signed, treasury will schedule invoice issuance and set up intercompany clearing. Confirm IBAN for Redwood EU (IT example): IT60 X054 2811 1010 0000 0123 456. If any changes, loop treasury.

maria_legal: Thanks. If anyone sees a procurement comment about governing law change, flag immediately we don't change governing law in addendum.

leo_sales: Thanks team thumbsup: routing now and will post redline link here when ready.
